QuestInfo.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
QuestInfo.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter
QuestInfo.1: Amazingly, Ayan recovered from amnesia with the help of the toy sword. That's just amazing!!! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally meet up, but first, I got to get this letter from Ayan to Bruce.
QuestInfo.2: I'm so glad that Ayan got her memory back. I'm even gladder that Bruce got to finally see his daughter again! What a moment...

0.0: Please give this letter to my dad! I really mean it! I can't wait to meet my dad again!

1.0: Oh... that's... my... daughter... indeed... I... can't believe it... I don't think I have ever been so happy in my life... thank you so much.
1.1: I am so glad my daughter is alive and well! I have to make my way there now. I cannot wait to see her. Here's some money for your traveling expense. It may not be much, but please take it.

yes.0: This is too good to be true!

lost.0: Please take care of it! I'll write it again here. Don't lose it this time!
